thread:
Devon L: Heads-up — Northbridge RFI got bumped: they want a capability matrix + completed security questionnaire + a concrete POC schedule. Deadline they gave is EOD tomorrow for the written answers. I uploaded a starter sheet and the questionnaire to the drive: https://drive.redwood.example/northbridge/poc. Can ops/product confirm dedicated capacity availability for a 2-week pilot? cc @Maria @Alex
Maria K: Quick answer on dedicated: we can reserve 2 x A100-equivalent nodes for 2 weeks, but needs a PO + signed SLA. I need infra confirmation on exact host mapping (we might substitute with A40 depending on region). What's their expected peak QPS so I can size batchers?
Alex P: From the RFI: they expect ~250 concurrent embedding calls at peak. Back-of-envelope that’s ~12k tokens/min, with spikes. For pricing we should propose two options: reserved Dedicated commit (flat monthly) + overage per token, or hosted trial with a hard token cap. Which do we want to present? cc @Sarah
Sarah J: I'll draft pricing options. Proposed skeleton: 1) Dedicated pilot: 2-week reserved @ $12k/week + overage $0.0006/token. 2) Hosted trial: 30-day free tier up to 500k tokens then $0.0012/token. Numbers are placeholders until finance sanity-checks. I’ll upload a sheet in the same drive folder. :memo:
Devon L: Security Qs they highlighted: KMS/HSM support, SOC2 evidence, data residency controls, and an ask about whether we can do HSM-backed keys for private deployments. @Prachi can you pull the short-form answers we can embed into the RFI?
Prachi R: Yes. Short answers: "KMS: customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated and Private via AWS KMS/GCP CMEK; HSM: supported for Private (on-prem) via PKCS#11 integration — requires SOW; SOC2: Type II report available (2024) — we can share under NDA; Data residency: we can spin up control plane in eu-west-1 or us-east-1 and keep inference nodes in-region per request; Audit logs: exportable to customer S3 / GCS. I'll drop a one-page summary into the drive"
Prachi R: Paste snippet for RFI: ``KMS/HSM: Customer-managed encryption supported. For HSM-backed keys, Private deployments integrate with customer HSMs (PKCS#11). SOC2 Type II report (2024) available upon NDA. Data residency achieved by deploying inference nodes in requested cloud region; audit logs available via Console -> Audit -> Export.`` Link: https://drive.redwood.example/northbridge/security_answers.pdf
Devon L: Runtime question from their infra: "automatic fallback to smaller models during capacity events" — can we put that as a capability row? Product/runtime team — is that supported out of the box?
Alex P: Yes — our smart routing supports model-variant fallback. Example config in rollout YAML: ``fallback_policy:\n  - prefer: redwood-medium\n    fallback: redwood-small\n    conditions: [cpu>80, queue_time>200ms]`` We should note that fallbacks are policy-driven and require compatibility checks for tokenization/limits.
Maria K: I'll add a row to the capability matrix: "auto model fallback (policy-driven)" with note about tokenization compatibility. Also adding rows for KMS/HSM, SOC2, data residency, audit logs, and POC node reservation. I'll attach the updated sheet to the thread once done.
Devon L: Great. Regarding sending this to Northbridge: I suggest we send the capability matrix + security answers now as "provisional" and follow up with finalized pricing once Sarah confirms. Include a line: "pilot capacity subject to PO and SLA". Legal — I'll loop in for NDA before sharing SOC2.
Sarah J: Draft pricing uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/northbridge/pricing_draft.xlsx. Please review and flag any unrealistic discounts. I put a placeholder for a 20% pilot discount.
Alex P: Pinged infra to lock nodes — will update by EOD. Also add a note in the deliverables for monitoring: "CloudWatch metrics + per-route latency dashboards" and include SRE on the SOW.
Prachi R: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and KMS integration notes to drive (same folder). Sharing link will require view-only after NDA.
Devon L: Thanks team. Action items recap: Maria — update & send capability matrix (mark pricing provisional). Sarah — finalize pricing and confirm discounting authority. Prachi — share security docs and one-pager. Alex — confirm node reservation and monitoring hooks. I’ll draft the outbound email to Northbridge and loop legal. Let’s keep replies short — goal is to send by tomorrow morning. :rocket:
